_comment: Clek-compatible stroller fragment. Sourced 2026-07-05. Bugaboo Donkey 5 (current 2023+ generation) in MONO (single) mode. Same physical stroller as bugaboo-donkey-5-twin; converts between mono and duo/twin modes. Do NOT edit seed.json.
name: Bugaboo Donkey 5 Mono (single mode)

clekListed.clekRow: Bugaboo | Donkey 5 (Mono) | Bugaboo Donkey 5 Mono Adapter for Maxi-Cosi | 855190MC01 | *Positions 3-5 only

_priceNote: Bugaboo.com now steers the US Donkey 5 line to the newer Donkey 6 and shows the Donkey 5 Mono as no longer available (no live DTC price). Strolleria still sells the Donkey 5 Mono complete at $1,749 in stock.

specs._weightNote: Bugaboo.com: Donkey 5 Mono with seat 33.28 lb (with bassinet 35.38 lb). Strolleria lists a 26.9 lb chassis/frame figure.
specs._unfoldedNote: Highest handlebar position per Bugaboo.com (lowest handlebar: 33.5 x 23.6 x 43.7 in). Mono width is 23.6 in; in DUO/TWIN mode the frame widens to 29.1 in (see bugaboo-donkey-5-twin).
specs._foldedNote: Compact two-piece fold per Bugaboo.com (35 x 23.6 x 13.8 in). A one-piece self-standing fold (20.5 x 23.6 x 35.4 in) is also available.

brake.type: foot-operated push-down/lift-up central pedal parking brake

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: birth (0 months, with included bassinet or a car seat via adapter); 0-4 years in seat

safety.standards: Sold in the US market (subject to CPSC 16 CFR 1227 / ASTM F833); Bugaboo does not publish a specific stroller-standard citation on the US product page.
safety.notes: 5-point adjustable harness (Bugaboo product page); central foot brake; UPF 50+ canopy; puncture-proof foam wheels with all-wheel suspension. Bugaboo does not advertise JPMA certification for the Donkey.

recall.note: Donkey 5 (2023+) is not recalled. CPSC's 2013 Bugaboo Donkey carry-handle recall covered only the original Donkey sold Jan 2011-Dec 2012.

specs.foldType: two-piece compact fold (one-piece self-standing fold also available)
specs.recline: multi-position reclining, reversible seat; bassinet from birth
specs.tires: puncture-proof foam-filled wheels, 10 in front / 12 in rear, all-wheel suspension

notes: This is the current-generation Bugaboo Donkey 5 (2023+) in MONO (single) mode - one seat, 23.6 in wide (as narrow as a single Bugaboo Fox 5). It is physically the SAME stroller as bugaboo-donkey-5-twin; it converts between mono (single) and duo/twin (side-by-side double) modes, so the twin file shares source pages and differs in seatCount, width, weight and price. Clek Liing attaches via the Bugaboo Donkey 5 Mono adapter for Maxi-Cosi (855190MC01 / adapter-855190mc01). CLEK CAVEAT: per Clek's official list the Liing is usable ONLY in Donkey handle positions 3-5 (the 30 lb cap flagged on the Donkey 2 rows is not repeated for the Donkey 5 rows). Best cited price $1,749 (Strolleria, in stock); Bugaboo.com now routes to the Donkey 6 and shows the Donkey 5 Mono as unavailable. Max child height not published by Bugaboo (null).
